or two or more related transactions in a 24-hour period, to report such transactions
electronically to FinCEN.14 The Los Angeles Fashion District GTO was effective from
October 9, 2014 through April 6, 2015.

statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: Under 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3), it is unlawful to structure transactions to evade reporting requirements. The fact pattern shows 12 cash withdrawals totaling $5,350.91, each kept below the $10,000 reporting threshold. These transactions occurred across multiple branches and dates, suggesting a deliberate effort to avoid triggering Currency Transaction Reports (CTRs). The proximity of these withdrawals to transit hubs and the use of various ATMs further supports the inference of structuring. Therefore, the conduct satisfies the elements of 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring.
